title: BrutalBlocks
description: This mod adds brutalist blocks like undyed concrete.
body:
[![github-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/github-singular_vector.svg)](https://github.com/therealfickle/Brutal)
[![fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
[![discord-plural](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_vector.svg)](https://discord.gg/B587E7veBZ)

This mod adds brutalist blocks, the current list of blocks is:
- Concrete (undyed)
  - Slabs and Stairs
- Concrete Bricks
- Concrete Tiles
- Concrete Powder (undyed)
- Rebar Concrete

It has full compatibility with vanilla recipes and such, and concrete is made the same way as dyed versions.
